thread:
kai: hey all, Kai here (started eng-sre shadow today). quick question: if i'm paired on oncall and hit a P0 but don't have access to prod DB or the incident dashboard yet, what's the sanctioned fast path for emergency access? don't want to do anything ad-hoc.
jamie (People Ops): welcome @kai! :wave: we have a "break-glass" emergency flow for new hires. People Ops can fast-track approval if you file an emergency-access ticket and your manager approves. i'll DM you the form link.
oliver (eng-sre): short version: 1) page eng-sre P0 on PagerDuty, 2) open #help ticket with "emergency-access: <name>", 3) request temporary Vault token + role-binding (hours-limited). we log everything. i'll grant short-lived DB read-only and dashboard-view while you triage.
zara (security): security must be cc'd for any break-glass. tokens are issued via Vault with a strict TTL and audit logging. do NOT copy creds into chat. if you need SQL write, that requires manager + security signoff.
lina (eng-manager): if this is during your first-week shadow, cc me in the PagerDuty page so I can approve inline. also please follow the incident runbook first: https://kb.redwood.ai/incidents/runbook-new-hires. the runbook has exact verbs to avoid accidental writes.
oliver (eng-sre): sample quick ticket to paste in #help:
```
Subject: emergency-access: kai
- PagerDuty page id: pd-12345
- Resources requested: rds/prod-db (read-only), dashboard/incident-ops
- TTL: 4h
- Manager: Lina (eng-sre)
- Purpose: triage P0 incident affecting inference latency
```
oncall-bot: PagerDuty page received (pd-12345). Eng-SRE oncall notified. Please follow the audit flow.
kai: thanks! one more: who are backups if primary eng-sre oncall doesn't respond in 15m?
oliver (eng-sre): backup chain: eng-sre oncall -> eng-platform oncall -> eng-sre lead (oliver) -> director (maria). page the next role with `/pd page eng-platform P0 "escalation for pd-12345"` if no ack in 15m.
zara (security): also file a post-incident access review after the ticket closes; security will revoke any issued tokens automatically at TTL but we need a review entry.
jamie (People Ops): i’ll add you to the incident shadow rota for the week and DM the quick-approve link. welcome aboard and great question :thumbsup:
